sub_sector.value: professional baseball franchise; mixed-use real estate development

product_category.detail: Live baseball tickets, concessions, merchandise, plus retail, dining, hotel and entertainment at The Battery Atlanta.

market_position.detail: Major League Baseball franchise with a premium mixed-use district of chef-driven restaurants, hotels and office space.

distribution_model.detail: Sells tickets, concessions and merchandise at its own ballpark; leases mixed-use space; licenses brand and broadcasts.

purchase_frequency.detail: Fans buy game tickets and visit the mixed-use district at their own discretion.

notes: Broadcasting revenue and sponsorships are also large, but they are not consumer purchases.
